description: Hybrid L0 overview / Fleet Command Center. First screen: status strip, compact First Action route, and Review Domain Status evidence matrix above fold. Aggregate-first triage; exact run forensics via Run Explorer and Trust. run_id is HTTP identity context only — never a Prometheus label.

panels.title: Inspect Alerts
panels.description: Contains selected-range alert evidence for triage. It supports investigation but does not determine current Fleet Health; expand it after the first-screen verdict points to an alert condition.

panels.title: Review Active Alerts
panels.description: Shows firing and pending BioETL alerts from Prometheus for the active time range. An inactive row means no active alert was observed; an empty result or UNKNOWN means alert evidence is unavailable, not OK. Continue in Pipeline Diagnostics for blocker scope.

options.content: 0. Trust1. Overview (current)2. Pipeline Diagnostics3. Provider Health4. Data Quality5. Incident Workspace6. Run Explorer

panels.title: Navigate Dashboards
panels.description: Sanitizer-compatible navigation bus with native keyboard focus. Primary bus 0–4: Trust / Overview / Pipeline Diagnostics / Provider Health / Data Quality. Adjunct 5–6: Incident Workspace / Run Explorer. Current workspace is a non-interactive chip (aria-disabled + data-current=page, underlined) so active state is not color-only. Handoffs open same-tab, preserve current time range, and document scope reset or context mapping on cross-scope transitions. Chip colors are theme-safe for dark and light

options.content:
What is broken or degraded right now?
Scope: CURRENT = Status + First Action · SELECTED RUN = exact-run evidence
TIME RANGE = Review Domain Status and trends

panels.description: Distinguishes CURRENT Prometheus state, SELECTED RUN persisted HTTP evidence, and TIME RANGE history. Pipeline and Run Type affect current and historical evidence; Run ID never filters Prometheus. UNKNOWN means missing or stale evidence, never healthy.
panels.title: Inspect Scope & Evidence
Monitor Fleet Health
panels.description: Shows the sole current Fleet Health verdict. Status mapping: 0=OK, 1=WARN, >=2=CRIT, null=UNKNOWN. UNKNOWN means evidence is incomplete or missing; use First Action and Domain Status to continue.

panels.title: Review First Action
panels.description: Shows up to four highest-priority next actions for the current fleet/selectors (priority: Runtime > Control Plane > Gold lifecycle > DQ > Provider > Workflow > Monitor). Columns: Action (primary CTA, row pipeline preserved) → Priority (text color) → Why → Pipeline. Missing/empty scope falls back to NO_ROUTE. run_id is handoff context only — never a Prometheus label. When Priority is MONITOR and Fleet Health is OK, continue monitoring rather than escalating.

panels.title: Review Domain Status
panels.description: Summarizes current Control Plane, Runtime, Provider, Data Quality, Data Validation, and Workflow status for the selected scope. Values are 0=OK, 1=WARN, >=2=CRIT, and null/3=UNKNOWN; UNKNOWN means incomplete evidence, not OK. Open the affected domain for detail.

panels.title: Inspect Historical Trends
panels.description: Contains selected-range status trends. These panels provide historical evidence and do not determine current Fleet Health; gaps remain UNKNOWN rather than healthy.

panels.title: Track Runtime Blockers
panels.description: Shows Runtime status over the selected range for Pipeline and Run Type. Values are OK, WARN, CRIT, or UNKNOWN; missing samples remain UNKNOWN. This trend does not determine current Fleet Health; open Pipeline Diagnostics for current blockers.

panels.title: Track Data Quality Status
panels.description: Shows Data Quality status over the selected range for Pipeline and Run Type. Values are OK, WARN, CRIT, or UNKNOWN; missing samples remain UNKNOWN. This trend does not determine current Fleet Health; open Data Quality for current conditions.

panels.title: Track Gold Lifecycle
panels.description: Shows Gold lifecycle state over the selected range for Pipeline and Run Type. A disabled Gold stage is a valid non-error state, while gaps or missing series remain UNKNOWN. This trend does not determine current Fleet Health; continue in Pipeline Diagnostics or Trust.

panels.title: Inspect Range Evidence
panels.description: Contains selected-range run, terminal-state, and reject evidence. Empty history is not proof of current health, and these panels do not determine current Fleet Health.

panels.title: Review Failed Runs
panels.description: Lists failed-run samples in the selected range for Pipeline and Run Type. No rows means no matching failures were observed, not proof that current Fleet Health is OK; missing telemetry remains UNKNOWN. Open Pipeline Diagnostics to localize failures.

panels.title: Review Recent Terminal Runs
panels.description: Lists recent non-success terminal runs in the selected range, grouped by Pipeline. No rows means no matching terminal evidence, not proof that current Fleet Health is OK. Continue in Trust for persisted run evidence or Pipeline Diagnostics for execution detail.

panels.title: Track Silver Rejects
panels.description: Shows Silver reject count and rate for the selected range and scope. Zero can mean no rejects only when a run started and matching telemetry is present; no matching scope, a run not started, or missing evidence remains UNKNOWN. This panel does not determine current Fleet Health; use Data Quality or Run Explorer.

panels.title: Inspect Domain Diagnostics
panels.description: Contains current domain summaries and diagnostic routing. It supports the first-screen verdict and stays collapsed until Domain Status or First Action identifies an affected area.

options.content:
Raw metric entrypoints
bioetl_l0_status — current verdict · bioetl_l0_next_action_route — first-action route
bioetl_l0_input_status_selected — input status. Open Trust, Pipeline Diagnostics, Data Quality, or Provider Health for reasons.

panels.title: Inspect Run Context
panels.description: Contains compact HTTP-backed evidence for the selected run. Run Explorer is the primary exact-run investigation surface; aggregate scope does not guess a Run ID, and identifiers never become Prometheus labels.

panels.title: Review Run Identity
panels.description: Shows HTTP-backed identity for an exact Run ID. No matching rows are a valid empty result for the selected scope; backend unavailable means the query could not be evaluated. Verify /health/live before treating the result as expected. Open Run Explorer for complete run evidence.

defaults.noValue: Not resolved — no identity rows for the selected run/scope. Check backend health (/health/live), then select or reset run_id; this is not a valid empty run.

panels.title: Review Processed Records
panels.description: Shows HTTP-backed Bronze, Silver, and Gold record counts and outcomes. Zero is a recorded count. No matching rows are a valid empty result for the selected scope; backend unavailable means the query could not be evaluated. Verify /health/live. Open Run Explorer for complete accounting.

defaults.noValue: Not resolved — no processed-record rows. Check backend health and selector scope; backend unavailable is not a valid zero-record state.

list.description: Core scope: run_type selector bounded by pipeline; fallback: All run types for selected pipeline.

Run ID selector sourced from the local control-plane run-manifest catalog for the current pipeline/run_type scope. Grafana All values are normalized to an unbounded scope, so Run Type = All no longer empties the selector; Pipeline = All exposes aggregate exact-run handoff options from the catalog. This selector remains HTTP-backed and does not reintroduce run_id into Prometheus labels. Run ID options are ordered by start time descending from the control-plane catalog; Grafana sort is disabled so backend order is preserved.
